'''Raltac III''' was a terrestrial object located within the [[Raltac system/Legends|Raltac system]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] Territories. A band of criminals under the leadership of [[Grintlok]] had a safe house located in on the planet.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars Adventures: Princess Leia and the Royal Ransom]]'' {{1stm}}
